answer:
Based on the search results, Martha Ann Ricks presented her famous quilt (featuring the Liberian coffee tree) to **Queen Victoria** in 1892. Queen Victoria died on January 22, 1901.

The question asks what happened to "Buckingham" after the departure of the queen. This refers to **Buckingham Palace**. When Queen Victoria died and was succeeded by King Edward VII, who chose to live at Buckingham Palace full-time as the official royal residence, it became the primary home of the British monarchy. Before Queen Victoria's death, the monarch had primarily resided at Windsor Castle, with only a few weeks spent at Buckingham Palace per year. After Queen Victoria's passing in 1901, Buckingham Palace became the main residence of the British sovereigns.
